name: walkOut
meaning: follower for the TRAJ path, started by SetState(3) with speed 0x145, bias 0x800, arrive radius 0x32 (0x43aec5); stepped in state 3

name: walkBack
meaning: follower for the TRAJRET path, started by SetState(6) (0x43afa6); stepped in state 6

name: traj
meaning: PROPERTY_DAFFYLEVEL09_TRAJ trajectory (Scn_GetPropTrajectory 0x43a1f4); the walk to the sign

name: trajRet
meaning: PROPERTY_DAFFYLEVEL09_TRAJRET trajectory (0x43a20b); the walk back

name: swirlSign
meaning: the level's SwirlSign (Scenaric_FindByClass(89) 0x43a1e4). Queried with msg 0x3081 (= sign still on face 0) and flipped with msg 0x3d in state 5

name: elmer
meaning: the level's Elmer (Scenaric_FindByClass(90) 0x43a0c0); looked up but not read by this class

name: state
meaning: 0 holding the placard, 1 intro cinematic, 2 disguise cinematic, 3 walk out along TRAJ, 4/5 flip animations, 6 walk back, 7 idle facing Ralph (DaffyLevel09_SetState 0x43ac7f)

name: camera
meaning: PROPERTY_DAFFYLEVEL09_CAMERATRAJ camera record (Scn_GetPropCamera 0x43a189); its Vec3s at +8 is the eye position of the state-3 scripted camera

name: camRotX
meaning: pitch of the state-3 scripted camera: atan2(dVert, sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz)) in 4096ths, masked 0xfff (0x43a981)

name: camRotY
meaning: yaw of the state-3 scripted camera: atan2(-dx, dz) in 4096ths, masked 0xfff (0x43a9cd)

name: wolfFrozen
meaning: non-zero while this object holds the Wolf's UI freeze (msg 0xe reply, 0x43aeee); released with msg 0xf, and cleared by Reset and by msg 0xe

name: unke0
meaning: cleared by PostLoadInit (0x43a30e) and never read anywhere in the class

name: homePos
meaning: placed position, copied after SnapToGround (0x43a281); Reset teleports back to it

name: soundHandle
meaning: handle of sound 0x6a started when the placard goes up (0x43b1d5); cleared by PostLoadInit and Reset, never stopped

name: cineBox
meaning: PROPERTY_DAFFYLEVEL09_CINEBOX (0x43a10c); Cine_Start argument 3

name: cineSheepBox
meaning: PROPERTY_DAFFYLEVEL09_CINESHEEPBOX (0x43a172); Cine_Start argument 4

name: activationBox
meaning: PROPERTY_DAFFYLEVEL09_ACTIVATIONBOX (0x43a123); in state 7 Ralph inside it starts the intro cinematic

name: deguisBoxes
meaning: PROPERTY_DAFFYLEVEL09_BOXDEGUIS id list (0x43a15f): in state 7 Ralph inside one of them while wearing model set 4 runs the disguise branch

name: cine
meaning: PROPERTY_DAFFYLEVEL09_CINE (0x43a0e1); played by state 1

name: cineDeguis
meaning: PROPERTY_DAFFYLEVEL09_CINEDEGUIS (0x43a100); played by state 2

name: cineFlag
meaning: PROPERTY_DAFFYLEVEL09_CINEFLAG (0x43a235); Cine_Start argument 2 for state 1

name: cineDeguisFlag
meaning: PROPERTY_DAFFYLEVEL09_CINEDEGUISFLAG (0x43a254); Cine_Start argument 2 for state 2

name: placardTimeMs
meaning: ms left with the placard up: set to 2000 by msg 0 (0x43ab91) and counted down by g_dtMs in state 0; on expiry the Wolf is unfrozen and the scripted camera released

name: cinePlayed
meaning: latched when any of this object's cinematics has run; blocks the ACTIVATIONBOX trigger in state 7 (0x43a61c)

name: deguisCinePlayed
meaning: latched when the disguise branch has run once (0x43a717, 0x43a7e2); afterwards state 7 goes straight to the walk-out

name: cineText
meaning: PROPERTY_DAFFYLEVEL09_CINETEXT (0x43a1b3); the index passed to Text_GetClassString for state 1's dialogue

name: cineTextDeguis
meaning: PROPERTY_DAFFYLEVEL09_CINETEXTDEGUIS (0x43a1d2); the same for state 2

name: placard
meaning: a second body constructed in place by the factory (0x43b280) and initialised from a synthesised record (0x43a2c1): the sign Daffy holds up. Rendered only in state 0

name: placardRecord
meaning: the 0x14-byte WAR record synthesised by Scn_BuildRecordFromExport(2, ...) for the placard (0x43a2a9)

name: placardValid
meaning: 1 when the synthesised record resolved and the placard body was initialised (0x43a2d9)
